findings.evidence: Classifier.lean:475–486 defines both using only Group, MonoidHom, and group identities, with no topology hypotheses.
findings.fix: Move both declarations to a dedicated group-homomorphism conjugacy module under TauCeti/GroupTheory and import it here.
findings.issue: The purely algebraic monoidHomConjSetoid and monoidHomConjSetoid_iff belong in group theory; their current placement makes algebraic consumers import classifying-space machinery.

findings.evidence: Classifier.lean:259 assumes only pointed continuous maps and relative inverse homotopies; FundamentalGroup/HomotopyEquiv.lean already houses fundamentalGroup_map_bijective and related homotopy-invariance results.
findings.fix: Move it into TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/FundamentalGroup/HomotopyEquiv.lean as reusable API and use it here.
findings.issue: mapOfEq_bijective_of_homotopicRel_id is a general fundamental-group homotopy-invariance lemma hidden as a private classifier helper.

summary: Two general-purpose APIs are misplaced in the classifying-space classifier, unnecessarily tying their reuse to classifying-space theory.
